timeline_free_baseline.result: 42 tests passed, including all quotation tests, without timeline changes

payment_test.failure: Expected 9465155 fils for the 45% milestone; received 9465156 fils.
payment_test.cause: The initial referenceQuotation seed supplied an override only for its 50% milestone. 210336.79 × 45% = 94651.5555, so the correct default half-up calculation produced 94651.56; the source document explicitly prints 94651.55.
payment_test.resolution: Separate quotation commit 242ed7b adds q.payments[1].amountOverride = "94651.55". Financial calculation logic remains unchanged.

pagination_test.failure: Expected seven reference pages; initial quotation renderer produced eleven.
pagination_test.cause: The initial renderer used Helvetica wrapping measurements, a 697pt body boundary, extra row/header spacing, and source pageBreakBefore flags. Natural overflow created continuation pages before subsequent forced source breaks. Debug output showed separate pages ending before the Block partition continuation and before the Tiling / Interior Painting source breaks.
pagination_test.resolution: The quotation implementation reduced table-header advance from 17 to 14pt, row text padding from 3 to 0.2pt, section-heading height, changed body boundary to 710pt, applied 0.95 to source minHeight, moved the painting break to the section opening, and later registered Cera fonts. The completed quotation baseline renders seven pages.

causal_control.source: Original quotation seed/document/test text recovered read-only from the Build quotation management module implementation history; original painting-break placement reconstructed from its recorded change. Temporary files only; no shell commands from chat history were executed.
causal_control.command: npx vitest run --root /tmp/azzora-quotation-original-draft src/quotation/quotation.test.ts -t 'calculates milestones|renders seven reference pages'
causal_control.result: Both original failures reproduced identically with timeline code absent: 9465156 versus 9465155, and 11 versus 7 pages.
causal_control.classification: Independent unfinished quotation-draft defects, corrected by the separate quotation commit; not timeline regressions.
causal_control.chronology_limit: Quotation code was under concurrent development and uncommitted during the initial timeline work. Available per-command history lacks timestamps proving whether these failures first existed before the first timeline edit; the original CRM baseline had no quotation module.

browser_timeout_investigation.original_failure: Timed out waiting for Mark Complete after a task-row click in the broader CRM journey.
browser_timeout_investigation.current_reproduction: The original journey reran successfully in a fresh browser context against a dedicated local server; no TaskDrawer application fix was required.
browser_timeout_investigation.stabilization: Exact route headings, task count and selected drawer identity are awaited/asserted; persisted overview edits and dependency arrows are checked; complete journey tracing and failure screenshots/HTML are captured; try/finally closes the isolated browser context.
browser_timeout_investigation.resolved_test_harness_issue: An added project-tab check initially used role=button, but the existing tab is an anchor with role=link. Corrected only the test selector and reran successfully.
browser_timeout_investigation.historical_limit: The earlier timeout had no saved trace. Its exact historical cause remains unconfirmed; do not claim it was a fixed application defect.
